say:3:1220240001:1.text: The water is so clear, and there's no smell to it!
say:3:1220240001:1.source_cn: 这……这是……这是，水吗？\n这么清澈，一点味道都没有……

say:4:1220240002:0.text: This is amazing! How much does it cost, good sir? I hope I won't have to drain my wallet...
say:4:1220240002:0.source_cn: 这水太棒了！要多少钱呢？我的钱不够吧……？

say:5:1220240003:1.text: Hahaha! Don't worry, this water is free! It's just filtered seawater—take as much as you want!
say:5:1220240003:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈！放心吧，这水不贵！都是海水过滤的，要多少有多少！

say:6:1220240004:1.text: Don't hesitate. Use it however you like! From now on, you can use this water anytime you want.
say:6:1220240004:1.source_cn: 别磨蹭了，想用就用吧！以后这些水想怎么用就怎么用！

say:9:1220240005:0.text: Thank you, thank you so much! *Sniffling*
say:9:1220240005:0.source_cn: ……太、太、太感谢您了！太感谢您了！呜呜呜……

say:11:1220240006:0.text: Hey, stop clinging to me! You're crying on my shirt!
say:11:1220240006:0.source_cn: 喂！别扑过来！我的衣服都被你哭脏了！

say:12:1220240007:0.text: Merlin, don't just stand there! Help me out here!
say:12:1220240007:0.source_cn: 喂！梅林，别干看着，帮帮我啊！
say:12:1220240007:0.male: Merlin, don't just stand there! Help me out here!
say:12:1220240007:0.female: Merlin, don't just stand there! Help me out here!

say:14:1220240008:1.text: Hugin's really thoughtful, even if his words are as tough as an anvil.
say:14:1220240008:1.source_cn: 呼金真是体贴啊，就是嘴和铁砧一样硬。

say:15:1220240009:0.text:
S-sorry for losing my composure...
But really, thank you so much!
say:15:1220240009:0.source_cn: 抱、抱歉，我太失态了……\n但是，真的太感谢您了！

say:17:1220240010:0.text: On our last date, Fador actually proposed to me. He said we'll have our wedding ceremony next time he returns...
say:17:1220240010:0.source_cn: 其实，上次的约会，我和法迪订婚了。法迪跟我说，下次他回...

say:18:1220240011:1.text: I wanted to look my best for that day, and at least not smell bad...
say:18:1220240011:1.source_cn: 我一直想在那天打扮得体面一些，至少不要太难闻……

say:19:1220240012:1.text: But I was so worried since with the old water, no matter how much you washed, you'd still smell fishy.
say:19:1220240012:1.source_cn: 我也清楚，用以前那种水，不管怎么洗，身上都会有腥味的。

say:20:1220240013:1.text: But the water here so clean and pure! And it tastes wonderful... *sniffling*
say:20:1220240013:1.source_cn: 但，没想到，现在这些水……不光可以好好洗漱，还能用来喝...

say:21:1220240014:1.text: Miss Angie will definitely be the most beautiful bride in Rustport!
say:21:1220240014:1.source_cn: 安格妮小姐一定会是全锈锚港最漂亮的新娘子的！

say:22:1220240015:1.text: Thank you, little familiar! I'll definitely be the most beautiful bride...
say:22:1220240015:1.source_cn: 是、是的，谢谢你，使魔小姐！我一定会成为最漂亮的新娘……

say:23:1220240016:1.text: It's all thanks to you, Mister Dwarf! You're truly the greatest craftsman in the world!
say:23:1220240016:1.source_cn: 这都是多亏了您，谢谢您，矮人师傅，您真是全世界最最伟大...

say:24:1220240017:1.text: I'll definitely send you an invitation to my wedding!
say:24:1220240017:1.source_cn: 我结婚的时候，一定会给您发请柬！

say:25:1220240018:1.text: Haha! I'll be there for sure!
say:25:1220240018:1.source_cn: 哇哈哈哈哈！好啊！我到时候一定会去的！
